title: release-kit adopters.json, schema version 1
description: The repos the rollout bot (.github/workflows/rollout.yml) updates on each kit release, in waves: canary, then public, then private. scripts/rollout.mjs checks the same rules and reports every problem at once.

soakHours.description: Hours the canary runs a patch or minor kit release, healthy, before the public and private waves get it (rollout-resume.yml starts them). 0 turns the soak off; a major waits for approval instead.

branch.description: The branch the pull request targets.

wave.description: A public or private repo belongs in its own wave, or the canary.

reason.description: Why a disabled adopter is disabled (required then).
